snippet.title: EVE Frontier | Official Teaser Trailer | 'Awake Eternally'
snippet.description:
Founder Access: New Era - launches 11 June
🔗https://www.evefrontier.com/en/founderaccess

EVE Frontier is a space survival MMO for PC and Mac. Founder Access: New Era is a major update introducing new gameplay, features and content. It marks the end of closed alpha and the first public step in creating a visionary sci-fi survival experience. From June 11, players are free to share gameplay footage, impressions, and experiences with no restrictions, as the game enters a fully public phase of ongoing development.

Join the Community
